mapper.select: WITH user_tags AS ( SELECT tag_id FROM user_interest_tags WHERE user_id = #{userId} ), user_cats AS ( SELECT category_id FROM user_preferred_categories WHERE user_id = #{userId} ), excluded_blogs AS ( SELECT DISTINCT blog_id FROM user_behavior_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND behavior_type IN ('like', 'favorite', 'comment') ), recent_viewed AS ( SELECT DISTINCT blog_id FROM user_behavior_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND behavior_type = 'view' AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' ) SELECT b.id, b.title, LEFT(b.content, 200) as content, b.author_id, u.username as author_name, u.avatar_url as author_avatar, b.status, b.like_count, b.view_count, b.category_id, c.name as category_name, b.created_at, b.updated_at, COALESCE(tag_match.cnt, 0) * 3 AS tag_score, CASE WHEN cat_match.cid IS NOT NULL THEN 5 ELSE 0 END AS cat_score FROM blogs b LEFT JOIN users u ON b.author_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT bt.blog_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bt.tag_id) AS cnt FROM blog_tags bt INNER JOIN user_tags ut ON bt.tag_id = ut.tag_id GROUP BY bt.blog_id ) tag_match ON b.id = tag_match.blog_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT #{userId} AS uid, uc.category_id AS cid FROM user_cats uc ) cat_match ON b.category_id = cat_match.cid WHERE b.status = 1 AND b.id NOT IN (SELECT blog_id FROM excluded_blogs) AND b.id NOT IN (SELECT blog_id FROM recent_viewed) ORDER BY (COALESCE(tag_match.cnt, 0) * 3 + CASE WHEN cat_match.cid IS NOT NULL THEN 5 ELSE 0 END + (COALESCE(b.view_count, 0) * 0.3 + COALESCE(b.like_count, 0) * 2) / (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - b.created_at)) / 86400 + 1) + 2.0 / (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - b.created_at)) / 86400 + 1) ) DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT b.id, b.title, LEFT(b.content, 200) as content, b.author_id, u.username as author_name, u.avatar_url as author_avatar, b.status, b.like_count, b.view_count, b.category_id, c.name as category_name, b.created_at, b.updated_at FROM blogs b LEFT JOIN users u ON b.author_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.id WHERE b.status = 1 ORDER BY (COALESCE(b.view_count, 0) * 0.3 + COALESCE(b.like_count, 0) * 2) / (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - b.created_at)) / 86400 + 1) + 2.0 / (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - b.created_at)) / 86400 + 1) DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM blogs WHERE status = 1
SELECT DISTINCT bt.tag_id FROM user_behavior_log ubl INNER JOIN blog_tags bt ON ubl.blog_id = bt.blog_id WHERE ubl.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT DISTINCT b.category_id FROM user_behavior_log ubl INNER JOIN blogs b ON ubl.blog_id = b.id WHERE ubl.user_id = #{userId} AND b.category_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.category_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_behavior_log (user_id, blog_id, behavior_type, score, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{blogId}, #{behaviorType}, #{score}, NOW())

INSERT INTO user_interest_tags (user_id, tag_id, weight, updated_at) SELECT #{userId}, bt.tag_id, SUM(CASE ubl.behavior_type WHEN 'like' THEN 3 WHEN 'favorite' THEN 5 WHEN 'comment' THEN 4 WHEN 'view' THEN 1 ELSE 1 END)::DECIMAL(10,4) AS weight, NOW() FROM user_behavior_log ubl INNER JOIN blog_tags bt ON ubl.blog_id = bt.blog_id WHERE ubl.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY bt.tag_id ON CONFLICT (user_id, tag_id) DO UPDATE SET weight = EXCLUDED.weight, updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO user_preferred_categories (user_id, category_id, weight, updated_at) SELECT #{userId}, b.category_id, SUM(CASE ubl.behavior_type WHEN 'like' THEN 3 WHEN 'favorite' THEN 5 WHEN 'comment' THEN 4 WHEN 'view' THEN 1 ELSE 1 END)::DECIMAL(10,4) AS weight, NOW() FROM user_behavior_log ubl INNER JOIN blogs b ON ubl.blog_id = b.id WHERE ubl.user_id = #{userId} AND b.category_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.category_id ON CONFLICT (user_id, category_id) DO UPDATE SET weight = EXCLUDED.weight, updated_at = NOW()
